title: 在残疾世界中生活成本高昂(6)
desc: 在残疾世界中生活成本高昂(6)

paragraphs.en: I am writing this … Why, exactly?
paragraphs.zh: 我写这些……究竟为什么？

paragraphs.en: Because, I think, I've had it with the pieties of neoliberal inclusionism.
paragraphs.zh: 因为我认为，我已经厌倦了新自由主义包容论的虔诚。

paragraphs.en: Because I've lost faith in our ability to put on the veil of ignorance – to construct the just utopia proposed by John Rawls, who thought we could best design a just world if we forgot our current social status, gender and religious beliefs, but who explicitly, as the philosopher Martha Nussbaum points out, excluded disability as an aspect of human diversity to be planned for in the New World.
paragraphs.zh: 因为我已不再相信我们有能力蒙上无知的面纱——去构建约翰·罗尔斯所提出的公正乌托邦。他主张，如果我们忘记当前的社会地位、性别和宗教信仰，就能最好地设计一个公正的世界；但正如哲学家玛莎·努斯鲍姆明确指出的那样，他将残疾排除在人类多样性之外，不将其纳入新世界中需要规划的部分。

paragraphs.en: I suppose it was just too hard to do that.
paragraphs.zh: 我想那就是太难做到了。

paragraphs.en: I am writing this because I am trying to reach back to a way of thinking that very nearly seems lost, though it was spelled out and fully developed around the time I was born; a way of thinking that allows work to be not the thing you get paid for, but, much more fundamentally, effort expended.
paragraphs.zh: 我写下这些，是因为我正试图回到一种几乎已经失传的思维方式，尽管它在我出生时就已经被明确阐述并充分发展出来；这种思维方式认为，工作不应被视为你获得报酬的事物，而应更根本地看作是一种付出的努力。

paragraphs.en: It is the shift from economics to physics – energy transferred from a body – though also, of course, from one economic mode to another.
paragraphs.zh: 这是从经济学转向物理学的过程——能量从一个物体转移出去，当然，也意味着从一种经济模式转向另一种。

paragraphs.en: I am not, perhaps, generating surplus value when opening the gate to my son's kindergarten.
paragraphs.zh: 当我为儿子的幼儿园开门时，或许并没有创造剩余价值。

paragraphs.en: I am, however, keeping the household afloat. And myself.
paragraphs.zh: 但我正在维持家庭的运转，也维持着我自己的状态。

paragraphs.en: I am moving about in the world, continuing on my route to my actual work, the one where I'm comfortably seated in front of my computer, writing these lines – expending, by comparison, barely any effort at all.
paragraphs.zh: 我穿梭于这个世界，继续走向我的真正工作，也就是我舒适地坐在电脑前，写下这些文字的工作——相比之下，几乎毫不费力。

paragraphs.en: And so, finally, I move from the gate to the kindergarten to the door to the building itself: also wooden, also heavy.
paragraphs.zh: 于是，最后，我从幼儿园的大门来到了大楼的门口：门也是木质的，同样很沉重。

paragraphs.en: In order to open it, I grab the latch with my left hand, using my right to very carefully guide the wheelchair backwards.
paragraphs.zh: 为了打开它，我用左手抓住门闩，右手小心翼翼地把轮椅往后退。

paragraphs.en: My arms have limited range, since contractures in my muscles don't allow them to stretch beyond a 45-degree angle.
paragraphs.zh: 我的手臂活动范围有限，因为肌肉挛缩使它们无法伸展超过45度角。

paragraphs.en: I can just about open the door to a point where I can guide the wheelchair forward again, forcing the door to stay open with my right front wheel, but it's a matter of luck, or how tired I am, whether I succeed.
paragraphs.zh: 我勉强能把门打开到可以再次推动轮椅前进的程度，用右前轮把门撑开，但我能否成功，全凭运气，或者说取决于我有多累。

paragraphs.en: Opening the door is not an automatic task, but something I repeatedly try and fail.
paragraphs.zh: 开门并非一件自然而然就能完成的事，而是我反复尝试却常常失败的任务。

paragraphs.en: And the day has hardly begun.
paragraphs.zh: 而这一天才刚刚开始。

paragraphs.en: I have a city to traverse, streets to cross, trams to ride, buttons to reach for.
paragraphs.zh: 我要穿越整座城市，穿过街道，乘坐有轨电车，去够各种按钮。

paragraphs.en: There will be much to do.
paragraphs.zh: 有很多事情等着我去做。

paragraphs.en: What does the utopian city look like, the one in which I participate "on an equal basis with others"?
paragraphs.zh: 乌托邦城市是什么样子的？那是一个我“与他人平等参与”的城市。

paragraphs.en: I have an inkling. I can envision the broad sidewalks and the spacious metro cars departing from perfectly level platforms.
paragraphs.zh: 我隐约能想象到宽阔的人行道，以及从完全平整的站台上驶出的宽敞地铁车厢。

paragraphs.en: I can see, just about, the absence of barriers that are clearly barriers, leftovers from a time when being able to walk was an absolute requirement for citizenship.
paragraphs.zh: 我几乎可以看见，那些明显是障碍物的隔断被彻底消除了——那是过去时代里，能够步行是公民身份基本要求的残余痕迹。

paragraphs.en: What I cannot see, cannot think into being, is a world where there is no greater effort required of me than of the average person, whoever they are.
paragraphs.zh: 但我无法想象、也无法构想的是：一个不需要我付出比普通人更多努力的世界，无论他们是谁。

paragraphs.en: Where the difference between us is erased and I, driving my large, black, powered wheelchair, blend into the crowd.
paragraphs.zh: 在那里，我们之间的差异被抹去，而我驾驶着那辆大型黑色电动轮椅，融入了人群之中。
